title: 第13章 雾霾之中一第14章 雾霾之中二
slug: 领主我在苦痛世界养成少女
content_zh:
“大人，货物全部打包好了。昨晚的‘支援物资’，包括七头牛，二十只羊，一匹驮马，以及其他林林总总的东西，全都记上您的账本并打包完毕。”
管家卡里姆穿着得体的布衫，但表情却瘪闷的很，没人会对进入北境而高兴。他们站在城墙上远眺，除了连接到苍穹的灰雾，还是只有灰雾。
他不是没想过逃跑，但菲尔德不给他任何机会。
山猫等奴隶兵，在金钱的腐化下，已经彻底成为了菲尔德的死忠，卡姆敢保证，他只要一跑，立刻会被那帮该死的走狗杀死，然后菲尔德会赏赐他们一枚银币。
该死的走狗，为了钱就腐化灵魂，连命都不要了，管家心里暗骂。
奴隶就是这样，只要你给他们一点希望和优待，他们就敢奉献生命。
“对了，大人。”卡奥犹豫再三，瞥了好几次阿诗娜，忍不住询问，“那个奴隶，对不起，我是说阿诗娜小姐，真是神选者，不是在骗我们吧？能不能展现一下神迹。”
菲尔德为了鼓励人心，昨晚召集众人，宣布了神选者的消息。
“我还要向你证明？要不你来开拓，我给你当管家？就是不知道，你能不能在帝国的围剿下活下来。”菲尔德阻止了阿诗娜召唤巨狼的想法，冷哼一声，蹙眉盯着管家，这个不忠心的管家，全程都在说丧气话，要不是看在他是唯二会读写的人，菲尔德恨不得让他做马夫。
是时候敲打他一下了。
卡奥感受到了压力，冷汗立刻从额头滑落，“呃”了一声，不敢说话。
自己的主子，简直和之前判若两人，或许是家族给他的压力太大？应该如此，毕竟自己也不愿进入诅咒之地，养尊处优的贵族肯定更不想，卡奥脑子乱成了浆糊。
“没有异议，那就出发！”
菲尔德点燃了驱雾灯，一盏二十五金币的价格，每分钟的燃烧，都是在往火里撒钱。
咬咬牙，菲尔德一脚踏入北境行省，周围一切的声音或者活物的气息骤然消失。取而代之的，只有恐怖的寂静。抬起头，菲尔德看到笼罩在周围灰沉沉的死亡之雾，诡异寂静，甚至连太阳都看不到。待久了，就会产生处在深海的错觉，连菲尔德都感觉到紧张和害怕，更别说奴隶了。
要不是离开驱雾灯会被腐化，而且菲尔德向众人公布了神选者的消息，恐怕他们此刻早就失去理智，一头撞进灰雾之中，然后被腐化成怪物。
地上都是红黑的蠕动“触手”，这是被腐化的植物，没有攻击力，但会缠上车轮。
“真特么的像寂静岭。”菲尔德强迫自己保持镇定，走在队伍的前方，让他们看到自己，引导众人前进，并给予他们勇气。
毕竟惜命的贵族都在，他们还有什么理由逃跑？
“嘎嘎嘎”

“吼！”
灰雾中不停传出各种诡异的叫声，驱雾灯照亮了前方百余步的距离，吼声则来自更远方，众人毫无安全感可言。
到处是破败的断垣残壁，地上还有腐蚀铁矛插着的干瘪脑袋，甚至菲尔德看到了褪色的狮鹫旗帜，帝国派遣过不少开拓军团，可惜都死完了，并很好的成为了“本地人”。
“咕噜~”
content_en:
"Sir, all the goods have been packed. Last night's 'support supplies', including seven cattle, twenty sheep, a pack horse, and various other things, have all been recorded in your account book and packed."
The butler Karim was wearing a decent cloth shirt, but his expression was very depressed. No one would be happy to enter the north. They stood on the city wall and looked into the distance. Apart from the gray mist connected to the sky, there was still only gray mist.
It's not like he didn't think about escaping, but Field didn't give him any chance.
The Bobcats and other slave soldiers, corrupted by money, have completely become Field's die-hard loyalists. Cam can guarantee that as soon as he runs away, he will be killed by those damn lackeys, and then Field will reward them with a silver coin.
Damn lackey, he corrupted his soul just for money, even at the cost of his life, the housekeeper cursed in his heart.
Slaves are like this, as long as you give them a little hope and preferential treatment, they dare to sacrifice their lives.
"By the way, sir." Kaa hesitated again and again, glanced at Ashina several times, and couldn't help but ask, "Slave, I'm sorry, I mean Miss Ashina, she is really the chosen one, isn't she lying to us? Can you show her a miracle?"
In order to encourage people, Field gathered everyone last night and announced the news of the Chosen One.
"Do I still want to prove to you? How about you come to explore and I will be your butler? I just don't know if you can survive the empire's siege." Field stopped Asuna's idea of ​​summoning the giant wolf. He snorted coldly and stared at the butler with a frown. This unfaithful butler kept saying depressing words throughout the process. If it weren't for the fact that he was the only one who could read and write, Field would have wanted to make him a groom.
Time to give him a whack.
Kaa felt the pressure, and cold sweat immediately fell from his forehead. He said "uh" and did not dare to speak.
His master is completely different from before. Perhaps the family has put too much pressure on him? It should be so. After all, he didn't want to enter the cursed land, and the pampered nobles certainly didn't want to. Kaa's mind was in a mess.
"No objection, let's go!"
Field lit the fog lamp. The price of a lamp was twenty-five gold coins, and every minute it burned was throwing money into the fire.
Gritting his teeth, Field stepped into the Northern Province, and all the sounds or breaths of living creatures around him suddenly disappeared. Instead, there was only terrifying silence. Raising his head, Field saw the gray fog of death surrounding him, it was strangely silent, and he couldn't even see the sun. If you stay for a long time, you will have the illusion of being in the deep sea. Even Field will feel nervous and scared, let alone the slaves.
If it weren't for the fact that they would be corrupted if they left the fog-repelling lamp, and that Field had announced the news of the Chosen One to everyone, I'm afraid they would have lost their minds at this moment, crashed into the gray fog, and then been corrupted into monsters.
There are red and black wriggling "tentacles" on the ground. They are corrupted plants. They have no attack power, but they will wrap around the wheels.
"It's really like Silent Hill." Field forced himself to stay calm and walked in front of the team, letting them see him, guiding everyone forward, and giving them courage.
After all, the nobles who care about their lives are here, so what reason do they have to run away?
"Quack quack"
"Roar!"
Various strange cries kept coming from the gray fog. The fog lights illuminated a distance of more than a hundred steps ahead, and the roars came from farther away. No one felt safe at all.
There were dilapidated ruins everywhere, withered heads stuck with corroded iron spears on the ground, and Field even saw the faded gryphon flag. The empire had sent many pioneering legions, but unfortunately they all died and became "locals" very well.
"Gulu~"
